title: Local dimension of a flat quasi-finite chart over a smooth scheme
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X and P schemes [def-pc-scheme], h:X→P a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite] locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] morphism, and g:P→Spec k smooth of relative dimension n∈ℕ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. For every x∈X, the local topological Krull dimension at x [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] equals n. The morphism h need not be etale or have separable residue extensions.

proof.text: For any open neighbourhood U of x, the morphism f:U→P is flat, locally quasi-finite and locally finitely presented. Its image V is open by 01UA and nonempty since x∈U. The open restriction of g to V remains smooth of relative dimension n. Both P and V therefore have dimension n.

Quasi-finiteness gives injectivity on comparable points. The proved source theorem topologicalKrullDim_le_of_continuous therefore bounds dim U by dim P=n. To get the reverse inequality, write dim V as the supremum of coheights of its points. Lift each z∈V to a∈U. The open embedding V→P preserves coheight, and flat quasi-finite coheight invariance identifies coheight of f(a) with coheight of a, which is at most dim U. Thus n=dim V≤dim U.
All open neighbourhoods of x have dimension n. Apply the proved source theorem topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_of_forall, which unfolds the infimum defining local dimension.
